entities.name: Trystan
entities.description: An elf druid and warlock of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, Morcant's poison master and horticulturist, who secretly despises the queen.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: Queen of the elves of Lys Alana whom Trystan serves as poison master.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: Elven realm from which Trystan spends much time away researching flora.

events.summary: Trystan gains Morcant's favor as an attendant and advisor, then becomes her poison master and horticulturist.
events.quote: He quickly gained favor with Morcant as an attendant and advisor before moving into his current role

events.summary: Trystan secretly despises the queen and wishes to lead the elves himself.
events.quote: Trystan despises the queen and wishes that it were him, not her, leading the elves
